_comment: Group attack distributed mode demo: box-select three player regiments (Spearmen/Infantry/Archers, seed 12345, front ranks on the y=300 line), press X to switch from focused to distributed attack, then right-click the enemy Spearmen at (120,727.5). Each selected unit automatically targets a different nearby enemy instead of all piling onto one. The HUD flashes 'Attack: distributed' when X is pressed.
